served.stem: The firefly luciferase result best supports which conclusion about the old solubility correlation?
choices: It rested on measurements that later turned out to be mistaken
It applies only to agents that are gases at room temperature
It shows that enzymes rather than ion channels are the real targets
It holds for proteins in a test tube but breaks down in the tissue of a living animal
It fits protein binding just as well, so it cannot single out lipid
served.bankWhy: Paragraph 6 draws exactly this lesson. A protein with no membrane near it reproduces the correlation, so the correlation was never evidence for lipid in particular, only for these molecules lodging in any oily pocket.

passage.title: Why Anaesthesia Still Lacks an Explanation

distractorNotes: The passage never doubts the measurements. It doubts what they were pointing at.
Nothing restricts the correlation to gases, and propofol is described as an oily liquid.
Luciferase is used as a demonstration, not offered as a target in the brain.
The passage does not set the test tube against the animal here. It uses the test tube to reread the correlation.

answer.text: It fits protein binding just as well, so it cannot single out lipid
answer.line: Paragraph 6: if a lone protein reproduces the correlation, the correlation never pointed at lipid in particular.

steps: Find the luciferase result in paragraph 6. A soluble protein with no membrane near it is switched off in nearly the order of clinical potency.
Read the author's own conclusion in sentence 4: "the correlation never pointed at lipid in particular".
Sentence 5 gives the why: these agents lodge in any oily pocket, in a bilayer or inside a protein.
Match the choice at that strength. Protein fits too.

choices.text: It rested on measurements that later turned out to be mistaken
choices.note: Luciferase reproduces the correlation. What gave way was the reading that it pointed at lipid, not the measurements behind it.

choices.text: It applies only to agents that are gases at room temperature
choices.note: Nothing in the passage limits the correlation to gases. Paragraph 2 ranks the available agents, whatever their form.

choices.text: It shows that enzymes rather than ion channels are the real targets
choices.note: Luciferase is a test case, not a target in the brain. Paragraph 7 names receptors and ion channels as the targets the field found.

choices.text: It holds for proteins in a test tube but breaks down in the tissue of a living animal
choices.note: The correlation was first found in animals, in paragraph 2. Luciferase shows it also holds in a test tube, not that it breaks down in the body.

choices.text: It fits protein binding just as well, so it cannot single out lipid
choices.note: Membrane and protein both fit the correlation, so it cannot point at lipid alone.
